matches.rationale: Finding 3 targets exactly the corrupted Assumptions block, objecting to the 'non-square-integrable' Hermite terms and to the heavy-tailed/unbounded-spectrum assumption conflicting with the finiteness the paper's own quantities (U, v_t², s_t², Tr(Σ)/d, ρ_Σ) require.
No finding addresses the hedged/altered definition of the generalization loss L_gen = L_test − L_train or the weakened KL-bound statement for E_score.

pred_verdicts.rationale: Reports an inverse-eigenvalue/timescale inconsistency not present in the ground-truth defect list.
Flags a Γ_t vs √Γ_t argument issue in Eq. (14), unrelated to any listed ground-truth corruption.
Correctly identifies the corrupted Assumptions block (non-square-integrable Hermite terms, unbounded spectrum).
Concerns the scaling of τ_mem with n relative to Theorem 3.2, a different issue from the listed defects.
